This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Skeleton Crew" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|grayish]] skin, possessing six long [[limb]]s, two legs and four arms, with large appendages and flat faces.<ref name="Skeleton Crew" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During the [[New Republic Era]], by around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Skeleton Crew Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> a member of this species could be found playing a stringed instrument for guests at the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]].<ref name="Skeleton Crew" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates|fifth episode]] of the television series ''[[Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="Skeleton Crew" /> which was released on [[December 24]], [[2024]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}}</ref>
